question: Can the claimed Sidorenko counterexample be independently tested outside its author Lean tree?

nodes.title: Reconstruct the claimed bipartite pattern H
nodes.detail: The pinned face table yields an incidence graph with 35 vertices and 66 edges, checked by separate edge-count methods. This only checks the encoded pattern.

nodes.title: The finite host G has not been published
nodes.detail: The upstream proof gives an existence argument from a counter-kernel; no concrete host order, adjacency list, or graph6 witness is supplied.

nodes.title: Produce and independently check host G
nodes.detail: Extract an explicit host and compute both homomorphism density and edge density independently against the exact 66-edge inequality. Until then, the finite witness is not replayed.
